page_title: SUN 3-2 BOU | Sunderland v Bournemouth 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+12' Tim Robinson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Romaine Mundle (Sunderland) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+6' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) receives a red card after his horrific challenge and is sent off!
90+3' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90+3' David Brooks (Bournemouth) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+1' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' This is a yellow card! Robin Roefs (Sunderland) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
88' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tim Robinson saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Bournemouth in a dangerous position.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland) is brought on as a substitute for Enzo Le Fee.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the bar!
83' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
82' Romaine Mundle (Sunderland) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bournemouth.
80' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Adam Smith will be replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
80' That will be all from Evanilson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth).

79' David Brooks (Bournemouth) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Robin Roefs has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

78' Bournemouth are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
76' A cross from Trai Hume (Sunderland) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
74' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
73' Corner kick. Bournemouth will have an opportunity.
71' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) replaces Tyler Adams.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amine Adli trots off the pitch and is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).

69' 3 - 2 A perfectly taken corner kick. Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the bottom left corner, increasing the score of today's match – 3:2.
69' The linesman makes the right call and Sunderland will have a corner.
68' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
65' Trai Hume (Sunderland) has tested the patience of referee Tim Robinson and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Here is a change. Wilson Isidor is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Brian Brobbey (Sunderland).
63' Regis Le Bris has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Romaine Mundle (Sunderland) replacing Chemsdine Talbi.
63' Substitution. Bertrand Traore makes his way off the pitch and Trai Hume (Sunderland) comes on as his replacement.
62' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
60' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amine Adli departs the field of play to be replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
58' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) replaces Tyler Adams.
56' The ball possession is 51:49.
54' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
53' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' The Bournemouth players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' The goal by Bournemouth is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
49' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Bournemouth players aren’t happy.
48' A goal, which was scored by Evanilson (Bournemouth), was disallowed due to offside.
46' 2 - 2 Goal! Granit Xhaka tees up Bertrand Traore (Sunderland) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:2.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alex Scott is replaced by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+9' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+8' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
45+7' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
45+6' The resulting corner, taken by Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland), comes to nothing.
45+5' Sunderland are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
45+3' Tim Robinson interrupts the game. One of the players from Sunderland won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
45+1' Looks like Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 3:1.
42' Evanilson (Bournemouth) jumps into a tackle and Tim Robinson signals a foul.
40' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
39' A pass lands at the feet of Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Bournemouth have a corner.
37' Bournemouth keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
35' Wasted opportunity! Alex Scott (Bournemouth) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
33' The total number of attempts is 6:8.

31' Bertrand Traore (Sunderland) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Djordje Petrovic pulls off an easy save.
30' 1 - 2 Goal! Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Djordje Petrovic into the top left corner.
30' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
29' Referee Tim Robinson is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Sunderland!
29' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Sunderland using VAR. Let's see what happens.
27' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Sunderland!
25' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
23' The ball possession at the moment is 58:42.
21' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tim Robinson had an easy-decision to make.

19' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Robin Roefs pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going in off the crossbar.
17' The ball goes out of play. Sunderland are awarded a corner kick.
16' The referee signals a corner kick to Sunderland.
15' 0 - 2 A mix up in midfield presents the ball to Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) and he coolly lobs a stranded Robin Roefs from distance to make the score 0:2.
14' The ball goes out of play. Sunderland are awarded a corner kick.
12' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
10' Tim Robinson blows his whistle after Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
9' Bournemouth are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Amine Adli (Bournemouth) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.

7' Evanilson (Bournemouth) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and tries a snap shot in the vicinity of the left post, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and brushes the post. That was a fantastic reflex save.
6' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
4' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
3' Evanilson (Bournemouth) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

Bournemouth will kick-off.
Tim Robinson is introduced as the referee for today's match.
